title: Rhythm and groove
summary: Read time signatures, count simple and compound time, and feel the 12/8 groove that sits under so much Afro and gospel music. Project: count and clap three songs.

videos.title: The difference between 3/4 and 6/8 time signatures (Music Matters)

practice.question: You tap your foot twice per bar, and each tap splits into three even notes. Which time signature fits best?
practice.explanation: Two felt beats, each made of three eighths: 2 x 3 = 6 eighth notes, which is 6/8. 3/4 would give three taps, each split in two.

practice.question: What does the 3 in 3/4 tell you?
options: There are three beats in each bar
Each beat is a third of a note
practice.explanation: The top number counts the beats in a bar; the bottom number (4) says each beat is a quarter note.

practice.question: A bar of 4/4 already has a half note and a quarter note. What could fill the rest?
practice.explanation: 2 + 1 = 3 beats used, so 1 beat is left. Two eighth notes are 0.5 + 0.5 = 1.

videos.title: Learn music theory in half an hour (Andrew Huang)

practice.question: How is a bar of 12/8 usually felt?
options: Six beats, each split into two
Three beats, each split into four
Four beats, each split into three
practice.explanation: 12 eighth notes grouped in threes: 12 / 3 = 4 felt beats. Count "1 la li, 2 la li, 3 la li, 4 la li".

practice.question: A chart says 4/4, but every beat of the groove rolls in three even notes. How should you think about it?
practice.explanation: Three even notes per beat is a triplet. Four beats of triplets is the same feel as 12/8, so count it in threes.

practice.question: In a 12/8 bar, you play only the first and third note of each group of three. What rhythm do you get?
practice.explanation: Leaving out the middle triplet makes long-short pairs. That bouncy rhythm is the shuffle heard in blues and older R&B.

project.title: Count and clap three songs
checklist: Chose a 4/4 song, a 3/4 or 6/8 song, and a 12/8 or triplet-feel song
Wrote the time signature of each song
Measured and wrote the tempo of each song in bpm
Wrote whether each beat divides into two or three
Recorded counting out loud and clapping eight bars of each song
Chose and practised a keyboard pattern that fits each groove
Recorded the keyboard pattern along with each song
